stem: What was the main purpose of this executive order?

options.label: A
options.text: To expand protections in hiring decisions

options.label: B
options.text: To guarantee a minimum wage for employees

options.label: C
options.text: To provide corporate tax cuts to companies

options.label: D
options.text: To provide on-the-job training for new workers

visual_elements:
The contractor will take affirmative action to ensure that applicants are employed, and that employees are treated during employment, without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

—Executive Order 11246 as amended, September 24, 1965
